svg.text: The narrow-band bake: pay the expensive query only where it matters
Every MeshSource::valueAt is a closest-point traversal PLUS a full sign query. A field graph with a mesh in it reaches 10^8 evaluations.
band: the exact SDF is computed here
far field, inside
far field, outside
Band voxels are O(res^2) out of O(res^3).
That ratio is the whole saving.
0. band-width floor
if (bandWidth < 1.5 * maxCell) bandWidth = 1.5 * maxCell;
The load-bearing correctness invariant: the band must be a
CLOSED barrier, or the flood leaks and half the model inverts.
1. band detection
An L-infinity box probe against cellOverlapsAABB per lattice
point, parallel over z-slabs. Conservative — the effective band
is up to sqrt(3) wider than nominal.
2. exact SDF, band only
parallelFor over the gathered band indices, calling the
expensive valueAt. This is the res-fold saving.
3. far-field SIGN
6-connected BFS seeded from every non-band voxel on the six
grid faces, with band voxels as barriers. Anything the flood
never reaches is enclosed, therefore inside.
4. far-field MAGNITUDE
Two-pass 26-neighbour chamfer with per-offset weights, so it
is correct on anisotropic cells. Band voxels are immutable
Dirichlet seeds.
The monotonicity argument
A non-band voxel only ever takes neighbour + w with w > 0, so its magnitude
strictly exceeds any band neighbour's — no spurious zero crossing at the band
boundary, and therefore no over-refinement of the octree in the far field.
